definitions.explanation: The physical property of a material to return to its original shape after being stretched or compressed.
The figurative ability to adapt or respond flexibly to changing circumstances, used for policies, plans, and organizations.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ゴム→ゴム：00073_gomu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{弾力性|だんりょくせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。

notes:
Combines ⟦{弾力|だんりょく}→弾力：14924_danryoku⟧ (elasticity) with the suffix ⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧ (nature/property). Used both for physical materials and figuratively for systems, policies, and approaches that can adapt.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {弾力性|だんりょくせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have elasticity/flexibility
- {弾力性|だんりょくせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}たせる→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to give flexibility to
- {弾力性|だんりょくせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{富|と}む→富む：12343_tomu⟧: to be rich in resilience
- {弾力性|だんりょくせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}う→失う：01887_ushinau⟧: to lose elasticity
- {弾力性|だんりょくせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{運用|うんよう}→運用：06811_unyou⟧: flexible management

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{柔軟性|じゅうなんせい}→柔軟性：05796_juunansei⟧: flexibility — broader term for pliability; more commonly used for people and thinking
- {伸縮性|しんしゅくせい}: stretchability — focuses specifically on the ability to stretch and contract
- ⟦{弾力|だんりょく}→弾力：14924_danryoku⟧: elasticity — the base noun without the ⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧ suffix; often used attributively (⟦{弾力|だんりょく}→弾力：14924_danryoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧)
